scenarios.purpose: Enumerate every river remaining after each compatible pair of private hands on a four-card board using a small no-raise tree.
Condition jointly on two selected rivers while exercising asymmetric stacks, multiple sizes, raises and all-in actions.
Nuts/air versus bluffcatcher, pot-size bet, finite tree
Weighted river range, two opening sizes, raises and unequal stacks

methodology.correctness: Every full serialized policy replayed from independent physical deals, numeric betting rules, best-five ranks and legal information-set BRs, absolute tolerance 1e-9 chips.
methodology.limitations: Synthetic small ranges and finite actions; conditioned rivers are not unconditional deck results. Binary64 arithmetic agreement is not an interval proof or commercial parity.
methodology.memory: Not measured; no memory/RSS or storage performance claim.
methodology.quality: Predeclared 0.001-chip NashConv target for each finite fixture; all misses retained. Equal iterations are not equal computation budgets.
methodology.timing: Rotating repeated complete solve plus deterministic JSON encoding; independent replay timed separately.
